title: Cycle Contract
description: The dispatches one /dev-overnight cycle allows after PM TRIAGE. Written only by the PM TRIAGE handler in hooks/posttool-subagent-track.py, when the PM TRIAGE dispatch returns, at <working root>/docs/dev/overnight/<sid>/cycle-<N>/cycle-contract.json, and never edited afterwards. Read by pretool-subagent-enforce.py at dispatch (G1) and posttool-overnight-file-check.py at collection (G3). An entry names no artifact: each dispatch's obligation declares its own.

cycle_id.description: lib.overnight.cycle_index of the session when PM TRIAGE returned.

required_calls.description: One entry per dispatch of a canonical step after PM TRIAGE (scripts/todo/dev-overnight.py _STEPS): once per pipeline the triage report creates, except a step whose dispatch carries a mode, once per cycle.

mode.description: The step's subagent_call.mode, a keyword the Agent prompt must carry, or null.

self_repair.description: T2.4 (BUG-B-Q0E-CONTRACT-SELF-REPAIR-GAP): optional contract-driven, audited grant that lets the cycle's dev role write to a narrow set of ~/.claude/* paths during an active overnight cycle. The object's absence (default) means self-repair is DISABLED and all existing hard blocks in pretool-overnight-hook-guard.py remain in force. When present and enabled, pretool-overnight-hook-guard.py allows the write iff (a) the acting role is in allowed_roles, (b) the realpath target startswith one of allowed_path_prefixes, (c) optional pipeline_id matches the active pipeline, (d) now() < expires_at. Fail-closed semantics: if any check fails, the grant is REVOKED and the existing hard block path runs unchanged.

enabled.description: Master switch. False (or object absent) preserves existing hard blocks.

allowed_roles.description: Subagent roles whose writes are eligible for the grant. Defaults to dev only.

allowed_path_prefixes.description: Realpath prefixes (boundary-aware) under which writes are permitted. Empty/absent disables grant.

pipeline_id.description: Optional pipeline identifier. When present, the acting subagent's pipeline_id must match exactly.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry (terminal Z). Grant is REVOKED once now() passes this timestamp.

max_files.description: Soft upper bound on number of audited files for this grant. Enforcement is advisory in v1; future versions may hard-cap.

audit_required.description: Retained from the grant's original shape; the grant writes no audit record.
